phases.title: Phase 1 · Evidence-driven V1
phases.description: Source analysis, scoped investigations and real browser proof on the trusted demo.

phases.title: V1 launch · Install & explore
phases.description: A guided console, uv/Homebrew installation, a static website and practical documentation.

phases.title: Phase 2 · Project usability
phases.description: Source-only project workflows, private history, honest verdicts and more reliable cleanup.

phases.title: Continuous improvement
phases.description: Small, reviewable improvements with a public record of their effect on ShadowLab.

entries.title: V1 baseline preserved
entries.impact: Preserved the implemented application: source discovery, scoped investigations, evidence, reports and reviewed demo fixes.

entries.title: Authorization checked through the browser
entries.impact: Added independent anonymous, Alice and Bob sessions, verified active identities, and compared owner and cross-user access against the same resources. Disposable patches repeat the same assertions.

entries.title: A guided local demo and simpler installation
entries.impact: Added shadow repl, a Demo option, Git-based uv and Homebrew installation, and a Next.js product landing page.

entries.title: Installation verified from GitHub
entries.impact: Recorded the real installed CLI workflow and its validation results, so the documented setup was backed by a working demo.

entries.title: The website became a separate static app
entries.impact: Separated the public landing page from the local investigation application. Vercel can host the product website without publishing the API, database or scanner.

entries.title: Vercel packaging corrected
entries.impact: Removed the incompatible output-directory override that caused the missing routes-manifest error. Verified the static app with the real Vercel Next.js builder.

entries.title: Installation links moved to main
entries.impact: Updated installers, website links and release checks to use main after the feature branch was removed.

entries.title: A practical documentation page
entries.impact: Added installation, demo and project instructions, plus nine sanitized screenshots and transcripts captured from real terminal sessions.

entries.title: A clearer landing page with accessible motion
entries.impact: Redesigned the public homepage, made Docs prominent, and added interactive previews and varied animation with pause controls, reduced-motion support and mobile checks.

entries.title: Your own project, inside the console
entries.impact: Added project selection, source-only scans, routes, findings, private history and reports. Improved diagnostics, cancellation and honest failure coverage; expanded installed-package and browser CI checks.

entries.title: A public record of every improvement
entries.impact: Added Phases to the navigation and a dated development timeline with commit links and product-impact notes. Builds collect available Git history, and repository guidance keeps future work summaries current.

entries.matchSubject: Improve REPL with discoverable slash commands
entries.title: A more useful command-driven console
entries.impact: Added slash commands, context-aware prompts, grouped help, session status, finding inspection, terminal completion and JSON demo exports. Strict argument checks preserve explicit patch approval and existing cancellation safeguards.
